name: Saeki Minami
source: Youngest sister of family. Is really stupid and immature for her age. Learns about sex from her friends and catches her brother going to sex club. Is afraid he is having sex with random people and confronts him. After learning more about sex she decides to she wants to have sex with person she loves most, her brother.
